user.title: Connect a PixLite Mk3
user.description: Discover controllers on the enabled Home Assistant network interfaces, or enter an address manually.

reconfigure.title: Connect a PixLite Mk3
reconfigure.description: Enter the controller address. API v1.9 is required. HTTPS uses port 4443 unless overridden and requires a trusted certificate.

reauth_confirm.title: Connect a PixLite Mk3
reauth_confirm.description: Enter the controller address. API v1.9 is required. HTTPS uses port 4443 unless overridden and requires a trusted certificate.

manual.title: Connect a PixLite Mk3
manual.description: Enter the controller address. API v1.9 is required. HTTPS uses port 4443 unless overridden and requires a trusted certificate.

discovery_confirm.title: Connect a PixLite Mk3
discovery_confirm.description: Connect to the controller at {host}. Its MAC address will be checked through the authenticated API before it is added. API v1.9 is required. HTTPS defaults to port 4443 and requires a trusted certificate.

select_device.title: Discovered PixLite controllers
select_device.description: Choose the controller to connect. Discovery does not change controller configuration or output.

no_devices.title: PixLite discovery
no_devices.description: No compatible controllers were found. Check enabled network interfaces, firewall and multicast access, or enter the address manually.

scan_failed.title: PixLite discovery
scan_failed.description: Discovery was incomplete or no enabled IPv4 interfaces were available. Try again or enter the controller address manually.

error.invalid_host: Enter an IPv4 address or hostname without a scheme, path or port.
error.invalid_auth: Authentication failed. Check the user and password.
error.unsupported_device: A PixLite Mk3 supporting API v1.9 is required.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot communicate with the controller. Check address, credentials, network and TLS certificate.
error.identity_mismatch: The API reports a different controller MAC address. Rescan and select the intended controller.
error.scan_incomplete: The scan was incomplete. These are partial results; additional controllers may be missing.

abort.wrong_device: This is a different controller. Add it as another integration entry.
abort.invalid_discovery: The discovery information is invalid. Rescan or enter the address manually.
abort.device_not_found: The selected controller is no longer in this scan. Scan again.
abort.cannot_connect: The discovered address could not be verified with the saved credentials. The saved address was not changed.
